description: This file contains unit tests for safe reading operations on file handles, specifically testing the behavior of reading to the end and reading up to a certain count from an opened or closed handle within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: read to end safely returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading to the end from a closed handle returns empty data.

methods.name: read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to read up to a count from a closed handle results in empty data.

methods.name: read to end safely reads pipe contents
methods.description: Checks that reading to the end from a pipe with data returns the correct string content.

methods.name: read safely up to count reads incrementally
methods.description: Ensures that reading up to a certain count reads data in parts and matches expected substrings.
